title: [WT-01] Daemon: settings.worktreeMode and the attempt workspace contract
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §7.1, §7.2, §1.1, §1.8 and §2.7 (target rule).

Objective: give the daemon the worktree-mode contract every wrapper slice builds on. The mode is pinned per attempt at claim time, so no task switches mode mid-flight.

Deliverable:
- ProjectSettings.worktreeMode: 'off' | 'on' in types/schema.ts, validated in state/validators.ts (anything else is rejected like any bad setting).
- An exported resolveWorktreeMode(settings) in state/validators.ts. It is the ONE place the default lives; the default is 'off' (WT-19 flips it).
- ExecutionAttempt.workspaceMode: 'shared' | 'worktree'.
- claimNextTask.ts sets workspaceMode from resolveWorktreeMode. In worktree mode it sets workspace = <projectPath>/.worktrees/<taskId> (today it is always state.projectPath), and the claim response carries workspace: { mode, path, branch, target }.
  - Worktree: branch = moe/task/<taskId>; target = settings.consolidationBranch when it is a literal name (no *, ? or [), else 'main'.
  - Shared: { mode: 'shared', path: projectPath }, with branch and target null.

NOT in scope: get_context exposure and complete_task branch policy (WT-02); finalize_attempt (WT-03); any wrapper change; flipping the default (WT-19); docs (WT-17).

Verification: cd packages/moe-daemon && npm run build && npx vitest run src/state/validators.test.ts src/tools/claimNextTask.test.ts src/tools/claimNextTask.contract.test.ts
definitionOfDone: state/validators.test.ts: worktreeMode accepts 'off' and 'on' and rejects any other value; resolveWorktreeMode returns 'off' for absent settings.

claimNextTask.test.ts: with worktreeMode 'on' the attempt records workspaceMode 'worktree' and workspace <projectPath>/.worktrees/<taskId>, and the claim response carries workspace {mode:'worktree', path, branch:'moe/task/<taskId>', target}.
claimNextTask.test.ts: with the setting absent or 'off' the attempt records workspaceMode 'shared' and workspace = projectPath, as today.
A test covers the target rule: literal consolidationBranch is used as is, a glob pattern or an unset value yields 'main'.
The verification command in the description exits 0.

comments.content: Spike self-review correction (epic rail 2: parity-check must pass on every task). Append this to this task's verification command, run from the repo root: `&& S=$(mktemp -d) && git archive HEAD scripts | tar -x -C "$S" && (cd "$S" && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh)`. Running it on a HEAD snapshot keeps a peer's mid-edit wrapper bytes from failing a task that never touches the wrappers.
